# Arizona Pigeon Proofing

> Solar panel pigeon proofing and cleaning for Arizona homeowners, fulfilled by local crews. Currently live in Tucson Metro, AZ; Phoenix Metro and the rest of Arizona are built but not yet fulfilled by a confirmed local crew.

Arizona Pigeon Proofing connects homeowners with local, licensed, insured crews for two services: bird mesh/deterrent installation for solar panel arrays ("pigeon proofing"), and deionized-water solar panel cleaning. Leads are routed to a confirmed local vendor per metro area; the site itself does not perform the work.

## Services

- [Pigeon Proofing for Solar Panels](https://www.arizonapigeonproofing.com/pigeon-proofing-solar-panels/): stainless mesh installation, existing-nest removal, HOA-compliant installs.
- [Solar Panel Cleaning](https://www.arizonapigeonproofing.com/solar-panel-cleaning/): deionized-water washes scheduled around Arizona's dust and monsoon season.

## Locations

- [Tucson Metro](https://www.arizonapigeonproofing.com/locations/tucson-metro/) — live now, 15 cities: Tucson, Oro Valley, Marana, Sahuarita, Green Valley, Vail, Catalina Foothills, Casas Adobes, South Tucson, Flowing Wells, Tanque Verde, Rita Ranch, Corona de Tucson, Saddlebrooke, Picture Rocks.
- [All locations](https://www.arizonapigeonproofing.com/locations/): Phoenix Metro and the rest of Arizona — pages built, awaiting a confirmed local vendor.

## Get a quote

- [Request a free quote](https://www.arizonapigeonproofing.com/quote/): name, phone, metro area, city, and service needed. Local crews follow up within 24–48 hours.

## Guides

Informational guides for Arizona homeowners, organized as four topic hubs with in-depth spoke articles under each. See the [full guides index](https://www.arizonapigeonproofing.com/guides/) for all articles.

- [Pigeons and Solar Panels: The Complete Arizona Guide](https://www.arizonapigeonproofing.com/guides/pigeons-and-solar-panels/): why pigeons nest under panels, damage and health risks, mesh vs. spikes/sonic/decoys, DIY vs. professional.
- [Solar Panel Cleaning in Arizona](https://www.arizonapigeonproofing.com/guides/solar-panel-cleaning-arizona/): dust/pollen output loss, monsoon season, cost, DIY risks, deionized water vs. pressure washing.
- [HOA Rules for Solar Panel Bird Proofing in Arizona](https://www.arizonapigeonproofing.com/guides/hoa-solar-panel-rules-arizona/): Arizona's solar access law, architectural review, HOA approval paperwork, rules by community.
- [Solar Panel Maintenance in Arizona](https://www.arizonapigeonproofing.com/guides/solar-panel-maintenance-arizona/): maintenance checklist, what decreases efficiency in the desert, choosing a maintenance company, bundling cleaning and proofing.
